vectors.description: Written by biosigIO 1.2.13 and not changed since.
Invalid because a version 2 reader MUST refuse a store whose format_version is greater than the highest version it implements (spec line 126), not because the store breaks another version 2 rule.
A version 1 store: no format_version, and recording_metadata as a string holding JSON text. A reader of the version 3 text MUST refuse it as unsupported.

One uniform int16 group of four EEG channels at their source rate, one valid interval, the declared missing value, and the zarr_conventions entry. A reader that does not implement missing_value MUST refuse it, naming missing_value.

The gap case of the text: 10 Hz, valid intervals [0, 20) and [24, 40), an event at 2.02 s with no sample, three onsets that are exact ties of round, one sample missing inside an interval, and view levels with factors 4 and 16.
v3-continuous with the group starting 1.5 s into the recording timeline. A reader that does not implement start_time MUST refuse it, naming start_time.

A uniform group and a timestamped group whose time holds the source's own sample times. A reader navigating by channel_groups reaches only the uniform group. zarr_conventions also holds an entry for a convention no reader knows.

Invalid because a name MUST NOT appear in both channel_groups and timestamped_groups, and channel_groups names only uniform groups; a JSON Schema cannot express a rule between two arrays, so no schema failure is cited.
v3-gap-10hz with overlapping valid intervals, [0, 30) and [24, 40). A JSON Schema cannot compare two intervals, so no schema failure is cited.
Fails writer conformance: zarr_conventions is REQUIRED (Proposed). A reader MUST NOT require it, so a reader reads the store.

Fails writer conformance: the biosig-zarr entry of zarr_conventions MUST NOT have members other than uuid, name, spec_url, schema_url and description. A reader identifies a store by format and format_version, so a reader reads the store.
